snippet.title: Land Sea Air Squad. [Arcade - Taito America Corp]. (1986). Area 188. Playthrough. 60Fps.
snippet.description:
.L.S.A. Squad. - Taito.
.Played By PiE. - "July 29th, 2021".
.
Arcade Museum - "L.S.A. Squad was produced by Taito in 1986.

Taito released 486 different machines in our database under this trade name, starting in 1967.

Other machines made by Taito during the time period L.S.A. Squad was produced include Alcon, Arkanoid, Battle Lane Vol. 5, Big Event Golf, Bobble Bobble, Lady Master of Kung Fu, Typhoon Gal, Super Dead Heat, Onna Sanshirou, and Metal Soldier Isaac 2.

An army combat game where the player controls a soldier who uses tanks, ships and helicopters to battle enemies on land, sea and in the air."
.
#Taito
#Retrogaming
